meta.author: Claude C (Independent Scientific Assurance), v3 GATE 1 lane2
meta.independence: Expectations were written from the SSOT text and the accname/HTML-AAM algorithms BEFORE running measure_geometry.py. No B code, B tests, or B worktrees were read.

label_relation_rule.SEMANTIC_EQUIV: pair present in synonym_map_fixed (no embedding auto-merge, 04 §5)

accessible_name_source_rule: ARIA_LABELLEDBY if aria-labelledby resolves to non-empty text (hidden referents included per accname 2B)
LABEL if name comes from an associated <label>

for name-from-content: VISIBLE_TEXT if DOM innerText or CSS ::before/::after generated text supplies the name (pseudo case flagged provenance=PSEUDO_ELEMENT); ALT if the content name is supplied by a descendant /
TITLE if title attribute is the only name source; VALUE if <input type=submit|button|reset value>
NONE if computed name is empty
meta.visible_label_text_rule: Rendered text a sighted user sees on the control at that state: innerText of a rendered (checkVisibility) control, PLUS CSS generated ::before/::after content (provenance PSEUDO_ELEMENT), PLUS input[type=submit|button|reset] value (provenance INPUT_VALUE). alt/title/aria-* are NOT visible text. Not rendered (display:none / visibility:hidden / off-viewport) => ''.

zone_rule_A_R7.authority: A T-A-V3-STEP1-003 R7 (entry_zone operational definition; D-V3-FINDING-007). Supersedes C's provisional thresholds (withdrawn, not reconciled — GATE1_PREREGISTRATION_C P-36/P-37).
zone_rule_A_R7.x_within_TOP: x < 1/3 -> TOP_LEFT ; 1/3 <= x < 2/3 -> TOP_CENTER ; x >= 2/3 -> TOP_RIGHT (MID/BOTTOM are not split by x)
zone_rule_A_R7.boundary_rule: [a, b): lower bound inclusive, upper exclusive, on both axes. The band table is canonical (A FACT_CORRECTION T-A-V3-FC-001 on D-V3-FACT_CORRECTION-001): y = 1/3 exactly -> MID (not TOP); x = 1/3 exactly inside TOP -> TOP_CENTER. No lane2 fixture centre lies on a boundary (y boundaries at 281.33 / 562.67 px; nearest fixture centre y = 522 px, bottom_sheet -> MID).
zone_rule_A_R7.coordinate_basis: control bbox centre normalised to the 390x844 viewport of the state in which the control is observed (entry_observed_state, GAP-07)
zone_rule_A_R7.structural_overrides: DRAWER > FLOATING > geometry. DRAWER: the control sits inside the reveal-requiring nav_container (the container that made menu_dependency=1; ANY nav_container_type incl. INLINE_EXPAND). FLOATING: computed position fixed or sticky, out of normal flow, pinned to the viewport; no size cap.
zone_rule_A_R7.C_operationalisation_of_FLOATING: R7 does not say whether 'computed position fixed|sticky' is tested on the control itself or on its nearest positioned box. C reads it as self-OR-ancestor (a control inside a position:fixed header is pinned to the viewport exactly like a FAB), so the three fixed-header fixtures (label_icon_text, label_icon_only_ax_named, label_alt_title_value) are FLOATING under R7. The self-only reading would give TOP_CENTER / TOP_RIGHT / TOP_CENTER for them; that reading is recorded as entry_zone_band_R7 so both values are visible (R7 'later_changes': declared sensitivity only).
zone_rule_A_R7.entry_zone_band_R7: geometry-only tercile band under R7 (no structural override), recorded per fixture as a declared sensitivity; raw entry_x_norm/entry_y_norm stay the primary comparison (+-0.02)

meta.entry_observed_state_rule: A T-A-V3-STEP1-012 GAP-07: entry_* geometry / label / AX facts are recorded at the state where the control first became observable; each row declares it as entry_observed_state = S0 | S1 | ... | POST_REVEAL:<nav_container_type>. s0_task_control_visible stays an S0 fact (false for reveal-gated controls).
meta.s0_task_control_visible_rule: A T-A-V3-STEP1-012 GAP-05: true iff the control bbox intersects the S0 viewport AND the control is hit-testable at S0 (elementFromPoint at its centre is the control or a descendant). Independent of task_control_occlusion; no threshold. Hit test is shadow-aware (elementFromPoint on the control's root node) so a control inside an open shadow root is not misreported as covered by its host.
meta.nav_container_chain_rule: A T-A-V3-STEP1-012 GAP-06: nav_container_type = the innermost container that directly holds the entry control; nav_container_chain = outer-to-inner array of container types opened on the way (len == nav_container_depth; [] when nav_container_type == NONE). measure_geometry derives one container per reveal step: the outermost ancestor of the control that flips from not-rendered to rendered at that step (fallback: the nearest fixed/absolute ancestor), typed from ITS OWN geometry — in-flow (static/relative) → INLINE_EXPAND; fixed/absolute with a pre-reveal box → motion of that box (LEFT/RIGHT/TOP/BOTTOM drawer), no motion → MODAL_MENU; no pre-reveal box → edge anchoring. The control's own motion is used whenever the control was laid out before the step (identical to the r2 single-step rule). Positive control drawer_nested_accordion (hamburger → left drawer → accordion holding the control): type INLINE_EXPAND, chain [LEFT_DRAWER, INLINE_EXPAND], depth 2 — a runner reporting the outer container (LEFT_DRAWER) or a one-element chain fails.
meta.null_convention: A T-A-V3-STEP1-012 GAP-04: at a state where the control is not observed (not rendered or outside the viewport), numeric fields (entry_x_norm, entry_y_norm) are null — never 0 — and categorical/text fields (visible_label_text, accessible_name, accessible_name_source, label_relation, entry_zone) are the explicit NOT_OBSERVED value — never ''. An observed-but-empty accessible name (label_icon_only_unnamed) is '' with accessible_name_source NONE: that is an observed absence, not a missing observation. One row never mixes the two conventions.
meta.dom_ax_divergence_rule: A T-A-V3-STEP1-012 'DOM_AX_divergence_noted' (W5E: querySelector finds no button, AX full tree has a named button): when the DOM channel and the AX channel disagree on whether the entry control exists at the observed state, both are recorded and dom_ax_divergence=true; neither side wins. Channels as C operationalises them: DOM = naive light-DOM document.querySelector(entry_selector) finds a rendered, in-viewport element (no shadow piercing — what a selector-based collector sees); AX = a CDP accessibility node for the control (located through the element's backendNodeId, which works inside open shadow roots), not ignored, with a role. Positive control dom_ax_divergence_positive: the control is an <a> inside an OPEN shadow root of a custom element — naive DOM: not found; AX: link '배송조회' → dom_ax_divergence=true. All 16 other fixtures expect false (both channels agree at the observed state, including the S0 rows of hidden controls where both are false).
meta.synonym_map_shape: frozen shape = canonical -> [forms]; identity (canonical -> canonical) is implicit. C-DECISION_REQUEST-031138 P-30 (C-decided, A confirmed in T-A-V3-STEP1-011): lane6 lookup is made bidirectional; lane2 expectations unchanged.

reveal_direction_rule_C.motion: delta of the entry control bbox center between closed and opened state (dx=x1-x0, dy=y1-y0). |dx|>=|dy| and |dx|>4 => LEFT if dx>0 (came in from the left edge) else RIGHT. |dy|>|dx| and |dy|>4 => TOP if dy>0 else BOTTOM.
reveal_direction_rule_C.no_motion_rendered_before: max(|dx|,|dy|)<=4 and the control was laid out before open => container fixed/absolute => CENTER; container in-flow => INLINE
reveal_direction_rule_C.not_rendered_before: control had no box before open (display:none) => container in-flow (static/relative) => INLINE; fixed/absolute covering >=90% viewport => CENTER; else edge-anchoring (touches top+full width TOP, bottom BOTTOM, left+full height LEFT, right RIGHT)
reveal_direction_rule_C.precedence: Geometry wins. class/id/data-*/aria-label naming NEVER decides reveal_direction; it is recorded only as naive_name_guess for the negative control.

meta.menu_dependency_rule: 1 iff the entry control is not visible at S0 and becomes visible only after >=1 reveal activation (OPEN_GLOBAL_MENU / OPEN_LOCAL_MENU / EXPAND_ACCORDION). nav_container_depth = number of reveal activations required (04 §5). A T-A-V3-STEP1-011 (P-09) fixes the primary reading as sequence-based (a reveal token before the endpoint); SWITCH_TAB is not a reveal token (P-06). On all 14 fixtures the only reveal in the recorded path is the one that exposes the control, so the S0-based wording above and the sequence-based primary yield identical values.

candidate_order_rule_CI14.authority: GATE1_RUNBOOK_C Addendum r8 CI-14 r2 (T-B-V3-BLK-016 part1/part2); Δ30 total order per RULING_INDEX Δ30-tiebreak; min4_sort_key per v2 A1 §5.1 line 366 (REFERENCE_DEFINITIONS 'dom_order 2차 키')
candidate_order_rule_CI14.candidate_list: fixtures that declare candidate_selector: every element matching it, enumerated in document order (querySelectorAll). Fixture-declared membership stands in for lane1 task binding, so task_binding_candidate=true for every enumerated element (lane1 tests binding itself; here the binding set is a given).
candidate_order_rule_CI14.dom_order: 0-based document-order index inside the candidate enumeration at that state (A1 §5.1: a structural value, never null)
candidate_order_rule_CI14.marked_primary: presence of the DOM attribute data-primary-action on the element (CI-14 r2: a DOM attribute, not an RF product)
candidate_order_rule_CI14.selector: tag#id of the candidate (3rd key; every candidate in C's fixtures has an id)
candidate_order_rule_CI14.delta30_order: sort key (task_binding_candidate desc, dom_order asc, selector asc)
candidate_order_rule_CI14.min4_order: sort key (marked_primary desc, dom_order asc, selector asc)
candidate_order_rule_CI14.comparator: order_explaining(selected) = DELTA30 if selected == delta30_order[0]; MIN4 if selected == min4_order[0] (and not DELTA30); NEITHER otherwise. Runner SELECTED must be explained by DELTA30 (must_not_flag on the observed Δ30 first); a min4-explained SELECTED is flagged (must_flag). The fixture is only live if the two firsts differ — measure_geometry fails the fixture otherwise.
candidate_order_rule_CI14.seam_refusal: a runner raising V3PathOrderDivergenceError on this fixture is recorded as SEAM_REFUSED — neither PASS nor FAIL until A rules whether refusal = 'v3 uses its own order'

expected.accessible_name_reasoning: link whose only content is ; name-from-content recurses into img and takes alt (HTML-AAM img). The img draws a truck icon, no rendered text, so visible text is ''

aux.accessible_name_reasoning: button with aria-hidden svg only; accname 2I tooltip (title) is the last fallback

HTML-AAM input type=submit: name = value attribute. The value IS rendered as the button caption, so it is also visible text (provenance INPUT_VALUE); innerText of an <input> is '' so a naive innerText reader would wrongly report VISIBLE_ONLY/AX_ONLY

expected.accessible_name_reasoning: accname 1.2 §2F.ii: name-from-content includes CSS generated ::before/::after textual content; Chromium implements this, so the AX name is expected to be '배송조회' even though DOM textContent is ''. If a browser does NOT include generated content the honest reading would be AX '' => VISIBLE_ONLY; the runner must report what the AX tree actually says, never synthesize.

fixtures.ambiguity: 04 §7 requires pseudo-element label text to be kept as rendered evidence with its own provenance. Two runner encodings satisfy §7: (a) visible_label_text='배송조회' + provenance=PSEUDO_ELEMENT, or (b) visible_label_text='' (DOM) + separate rendered_pseudo_text='배송조회'. A bare visible_label_text='' with no provenance field FAILS (label is visibly present on screen). accessible_name must come from the AX tree (expected '배송조회' in Chromium), never copied from the CSS.

expected.accessible_name_reasoning: S0 row: the control sits in a closed full-screen menu (visibility:hidden, opacity 0). It is not rendered and is excluded from the AX tree, so the S0 fact_surface_state row carries NOT_OBSERVED / NOT_OBSERVED (GAP-04: never '' or 0 for an unobserved control), null geometry, and modality HIDDEN_UNTIL_REVEAL. Post-reveal values are in after_reveal and are the entry_* record (entry_observed_state = POST_REVEAL:MODAL_MENU, GAP-07).

motion.note: fade-in overlay: control does not move; container is fixed and covers the viewport => CENTER

fixtures.ambiguity: S0 accessible_name for an element outside the AX tree: C records NOT_OBSERVED (A STEP1-012 GAP-04) with accessible_name_source / label_relation NOT_OBSERVED and null geometry, and defers the modality/relation of the control itself to the post-reveal state (entry_observed_state POST_REVEAL:<type>, GAP-07). A runner storing null for the text fields is equivalent; '' or 0 is not. It must NOT store the post-reveal name in the S0 row.

After OPEN_GLOBAL_MENU alone it is still hidden (accordion closed) — a runner that reports it visible after one step over-states depth; after EXPAND_ACCORDION it is an in-flow link '배송조회'.

Innermost = INLINE_EXPAND; band TOP_CENTER inside the drawer (x≈0.4, y<1/3) under R7 geometry, zone DRAWER.

fixtures.rationale: A T-A-V3-STEP1-012 'DOM_AX_divergence_noted' positive control: DOM channel (naive querySelector over the light DOM) does not find the control, AX channel does → dom_ax_divergence=true with both channels recorded. A runner that hard-codes false, or that lets one channel win (drops the row or reports the control absent), fails here; the other 16 fixtures expect false. The two orders diverge on the first element, which is the CI-14 r2 condition.

A runner whose SELECTED/rank is explained by min4 (button#marked) while claiming the Δ30 policy is a ruling_10 violation (Δ36-order); a runner that refuses (V3PathOrderDivergenceError) is recorded as SEAM_REFUSED.
